name: manual_5a28c6
claim: When diagnosing peer credentials, inspect only environment key presence and protected process loading; never include credential-bearing env files in broad content searches or echo token values into terminal output, board messages, handoffs, or tracked memory.

decisions.notes: Codex reviewer recovery audit identified an earlier broad local environment search that displayed a secret-bearing line. This sanitized lesson preserves the failure mechanism, not the value; any exposure requires operator-owned credential handling rather than silent automatic rotation.
